status: Exploratory extension; committed before evaluating these policies on external traces, not independently preregistered
model_selection: Fixed from schema and model identities, not observed held-out quality; includes lower-cost open-weight, lower-cost API, and two larger API models
observations: Parsed answer letters A-D, plus INVALID; only already acquired answers are visible to the controller
terminal_action: Select an already acquired model's original response, or defer; never fabricate the gold answer
split: Global normalized-prompt hash groups, 60% train / 20% development / 20% test, fixed salt dtmoa-external-v1; duplicate prompts never cross partitions
missing_data: Report all exclusions; retain invalid parsed responses; exclude rows only for missing/non-binary labels or missing/nonfinite/negative costs for any selected model
loss: wrong selected answer=1, defer=0.25; J=mean terminal loss + lambda_usd * sum historical logged estimated USD
calibration: Finite answer-vector distribution with independent-marginal smoothing; conditional candidate correctness learned only from calibration rows. Prior strength selected on development, separately per policy, then frozen.
candidate: fitted finite-horizon Bellman policy over observed answer states
uncertainty: Paired held-out question-group bootstrap, 2000 replicates; fixed-model conditional intervals, not independent retraining replications. Holm correction across the three primary comparisons; report micro and macro-family results.
shift_tests: Leave one benchmark family out entirely from calibration/development; evaluate its held-out test groups. If five-shot traces are available, evaluate zero-shot-trained frozen policies only on matched held-out sample IDs.
reproducibility: Pinned source revision and SHA-256; persist protocol hash, split and per-case decisions; repeat deterministic numeric evaluation; retain negative results
